exposure: Incompletely vaccinated (1 dose of Pfizer or Moderna)
Pregnant persons incompletely vaccinated against COVID-19
Completely vaccinated (1 dose of Johnson & Johnson or ≥2 doses of Moderna or Pfizer)
Pregnant persons completely vaccinated against COVID-19
cohort: 377,995 pregnant persons who delivered between January 2021 and April 2022 at hospitals in the United States
finding: Pregnant persons who were completely vaccinated against COVID-19 were less likely to have low birthweight neonates compared to unvaccinated and incompletely vaccinated individuals.
birth_weight: Low birth weight defined as ≤2500 g
